spec_cite: docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §4.4 (validation table: Configuration invalid -> receiving side Error(401)+Close(401))
description: Invalid Configuration pushed to the Client: codec CODEC_UNSPECIFIED with otherwise-valid PcmParameters — the receiving side answers Error(401)+Close(401).
preconditions: Session READY (authenticated, negotiated). Any ConfigurationPublished must carry a valid Configuration (spec §4.4).

codec UNSPECIFIED (0) is the proto3 default and is not encoded; its absence-with-pcm-present is what makes the message invalid per the validation table (a Configuration must set codec, and pcm is set iff codec == CODEC_PCM).

steps.note: codec omitted (UNSPECIFIED) although pcm is present.

assertions: The receiving side here is the CLIENT (ConfigurationPublished is a Server push); the Error/Close travel C->S and the transport close carries 401 from the Client side.
Unsolicited: request_id 0 (not encoded) on both the push and the reply Error.
The other invalid shapes (pcm absent for CODEC_PCM; sample_rate 0; channels 0; sample_format UNSPECIFIED) hit the same row — one representative is vectorized.
Contrast control.error-403: a VALID Configuration the receiver cannot decode is 403, not 401.
